theme: Last Florida day before the flight north.

needsAttention.detail: Breeze MX1004 out of Tampa tomorrow afternoon. The check-in email is already in your inbox — check in tonight and set the bag out so the morning doesn't get away from you.

needsAttention.detail: The p1 Todoist task is well overdue. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the tightest rental in that market and it sells out. Book refundable now; dates can flex later.

needsAttention.detail: The decision was due Sept 30 and the book-by date is Oct 15. Pick the domestic default or refundable-international only, then lock the shortlist of three.
